scope: sUSDe economic dependency structure; chain-local transport authority is assessed under Contract & Admin

upstream.name: USDe — the wrapper's sole economic underlying
upstream.metric: 100% of sUSDe vault assets are USDe
upstream.note: sUSDe is a pure wrapper. Its Backing and Dependencies scores may not outrank USDe on the same questions, and the default is equality rather than an automatic wrapper penalty. The vault adds exchange-rate accrual and cooldown mechanics, but no reserve diversification.

dependencies.downstream_tracking_note: Generated impact relationships will be rebuilt after this file is added. Aave, Morpho and Pendle are downstream concentration and exit-risk context; they are not upstream reserve dependencies and do not determine Axis 4.
dependencies.note: The canonical economic path is sUSDe to USDe and then through USDe's own dependency set. Chain-local OFT messaging and holder-control authority belong to Contract & Admin; they are not flattened into independent reserve assets here.
dependencies.upstream_resolution_rule: Every upstream row resolves through `slug`, `slugs`, `terminal: true` plus `kind`, or `unresolved`. The sole row resolves to the scored USDe assessment.

downstream_basis.asserted_only_note: None — every asserted edge is reproducible from an upstream array.
downstream_basis.do_not_hand_edit: ⚠️ downstream_tracked is GENERATED. Hand-maintaining both directions is how fxsave came to list fxUSD as BOTH its upstream and its downstream — one edge recorded twice, in opposite directions. Add the edge to the UPSTREAM array of the dependent asset and re-run build.
